description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness work across configured model APIs and supported vendor CLIs with dependency-aware packages and cost previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 规划有依赖的工作包，将其分配给已配置的模型 API 或支持的厂商 CLI，并提供费用预览。

description.en: Model Router and GALGame plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 做成本感知的模型路由，本地规划路线、对比配置、查看执行权限，还带 GALGame 玩法。

description.en: MCP server management UI for DeepSeek Harness Web — floating panel, JSON import, and profile-backed persistence.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Whole-project code review for DeepSeek Harness: five specialist reviewers, one severity-ordered report, a module/finding relation graph, and progress, ETA and cancellation for long runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全项目审查：五位专家、按严重度排列的总报告、模块/问题关系图，以及长任务的进度、ETA 和取消。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入可视化 Grok 主搜索与 Tavily、Exa、TinyFish、Firecrawl 自动回退，复用 grok-search-rs。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里可视化配置多来源搜索，Grok 主搜加 Tavily 等自动回退，一个插件搞定。

description.en: 由 Genca（缙嘉集团，上海缙嘉科技有限公司）VinkWork 团队开源的 DSH 插件：PSD 主图模板批量套 SKU、画布微调、整批导出。VinkWork 核心产品：VinkClaw.com。
description.zh: 把 PSD 主图模板批量套上不同 SKU，微调画布后整批导出，做电商主图省事多了。

description.en: 把 Ducktor 装进 DeepSeek Harness 的科研导师插件：Agent 推进研究的同时，为你补齐导师指引与科研训练闭环。
Personal memory sidebar and agent tools for Mory, with search, editing and optional GitHub/Gitee synchronization. Requires a Mory service installed and running on the DSH host.
description.zh: Mory 个人记忆侧栏与智能体工具，支持记忆检索、编辑及可选的 GitHub/Gitee 同步。需在 DSH 宿主机上先安装并启动 Mory 服务。

description.en: compact reasoning and tool activity groups for DeepSeek Harness Web and DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的推理过程、工具调用和图片压缩成紧凑分组，界面更清爽。

description.en: 把单一会话不可能的巨任务拆成无数可验证子系统，大规模并行有纪律执行
description.zh: 把超大任务拆成多个可验证的小子系统，并行执行，让单会话搞不定的活儿也能稳稳推进。

description.en: DSH 独立输入插件：UIA/窗口消息优先，不抢真实鼠标键盘；15 个 AI 光标状态自动切换。
description.zh: 把鼠标键盘操作拆成独立输入工具，只向指定窗口发 UIA 或窗口消息，不抢真实光标和焦点。

description.en: AI Love Companion Skill - 恋人主题AI角色扮演技能包 | 8套预设人设 | 自定义配置 | 记忆系统 | 情感识别 | 开源（CC BY-NC 4.0）
description.zh: 给AI一键装上恋人模式，8套预设人设随意切换，还能记住聊天细节、识别情绪。

description.en: Reverse-engineering agent preset. Mounts REA (rea-agents) as MCP tools for native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, managed assemblies, archives and installers — the full 170-tool catalog by default — but only inside sessions that select the preset; other presets load nothing. Ships an install-time check that reports which native analysis engine (Hopper, Ghidra, IDA) is present and prints the env snippet to wire one in. A fork of dsh-rea (JeremyWangCY, MIT) retargeted as an agent preset; do not install it together with dsh-rea.
description.zh: 逆向工程 agent 预设。把 REA（rea-agents）的原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron、托管程序集、归档与安装包分析能力作为 MCP 工具挂载——默认全量 170 个——但只在选择该预设的会话里生效，其它预设零加载。附带安装后环境自检：报告本机已装哪个原生分析引擎（Hopper / Ghidra / IDA），并给出接入所需的 env 片段。本插件是 dsh-rea（JeremyWangCY，MIT）的二次开发分支，改为 agent 预设，请勿与上游 dsh-rea 同时安装。

description.en: Agent Teams management for the DSH Web GUI: inspect the teammates of any session, delete a role together with its session (the session folder moves to a recoverable trash), reclaim the freed member slot on pre-0.2.2-rc.1 teams, keep deleted members out of the subagent picker and the team roster, and restore a read-only members panel in the session header on 0.2.2-rc.1+ — works with both the old and the new Agent Teams implementations without patching DSH.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的智能体团队管理：查看任意会话的成员，删除角色及其持久会话（目录移入回收站，可恢复），在 0.2.2-rc.1 之前的旧版团队上回收释放的成员名额，让已删除成员不再出现在子智能体选择器与团队面板，并在 0.2.2-rc.1+ 恢复会话页头的只读成员面板；新旧两版智能体团队实现都能用，不需要改 DSH 源码。

description.en: 更好的Goal实现 | Better goal tool for DSH
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个更好用的目标管理工具，帮你把目标拆解、跟踪并坚持做完。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness message editor (edit/delete/fold/fork) — desktop-adapted fork of dsh-chat-editor from DSH-CyberWorkStation (MIT)
description.zh: 能改写、删除、折叠任意一条消息，还能从任意一轮之前分叉会话，桌面端聊天编辑更顺手。

description.en: 网页版 AI 一键入口：在右侧边栏浏览器 tab 里打开 DeepSeek / Kimi / 豆包 / 腾讯元宝 / 通义千问 / 智谱清言的免费网页版（走 Electron webview，不受 CSP frame-ancestors 限制）。站点列表在 lib/client.js 的 SITES 常量里，可自由增删。
description.zh: 在侧边栏一键打开 DeepSeek、Kimi、豆包等六家 AI 网页版，和当前会话并排用，简单问题不用再花 API 钱。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把远端机器当本地用 —— 文件树、终端、SFTP 断点续传、按方向镜像的编辑同步，以及 -L / -D / -R 三种转发。
description.zh: 把远端机器当本地用：文件树、终端、SFTP 断点续传、编辑同步和三种端口转发一应俱全。

description.en: Session handoff: `/handoff` summarizes recent turns with an LLM, opens a new session in the same workspace with the summary as its first message, and can trigger automatically when the context window or session size grows. Supports DSH `0.1.0-rc.5`–`rc.8`, `0.1.1-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`.
description.zh: 用 /handoff 让 AI 总结当前对话，自动开新会话接着聊，上下文快满时还能自动触发。

description.en: Archive the original context before DSH compaction replaces it with a summary — wraps the official summarize(), no engine changes.
DSH 办公文档全能插件：docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf/odf/csv/html 读写改互转 + 内嵌离线 OCR（中文扫描件与乱码 PDF），零第三方依赖、装上不让 DSH 崩
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接读写和互转 Word、Excel、PPT、PDF 等办公文档，还能离线 OCR 识别。

description.en: EVA Unit-02 theme with an entry-plug boot cinematic, a context-based sync meter, and configurable dark interface styling.
description.zh: EVA 弐号机主题，提供插入栓启动演出、基于上下文余量的同步率表和可配置的深色界面样式。

description.en: Searches the whole conversation — not just the loaded window — from a button in the conversation header, opens the results in the right sidebar, paints every keyword yellow in both your messages and the replies, and jumps the conversation to the hit. History search runs on the host log, so it still works when the full-text index is disabled.
description.zh: 在对话头部加一个搜索按钮，结果显示在右侧栏；整段历史都能搜（不只是已加载的那部分），命中关键词在用户消息和 AI 回复里都标黄，点结果可跳转到对话中的位置。历史检索走宿主日志，所以全文索引被关闭时也能用。

description.en: Open folders on remote hosts over SSH as Harness workspaces: file tools (read/write/edit/grep/glob) and shell commands run directly on the remote host over SFTP, ripgrep, and ssh2 exec, with no local mirroring, an encrypted multi-host registry, and the local sandbox policy still enforced.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把远程主机目录作为 Harness 工作区打开：read/write/edit/grep/glob 与 shell 命令经 SFTP、ripgrep、ssh2 exec 直接在远程主机执行，不做本地镜像；多主机注册表加密存储，本地沙箱策略依然生效。

description.en: Frontend GUI debugging and testing for DeepSeekHarness agents: 36 browser_* tools for structured GUI automation, visual comparison, dynamic frame analysis and network debugging on Web/Chromium.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeekHarness 的前端 GUI 调试与测试：36 个 browser_* 工具，覆盖结构化 GUI 操作、视觉比对、动态帧分析与网络调试（Web/Chromium）。

description.en: Agentic RAG for DeepSeek Harness: three-path retrieval, document continuation reading and a knowledge-base panel.
DSH 助手人格与长期记忆插件：独立可用，不依赖其它插件。管 AI 自身的名字与角色、对用户的称呼、回复风格与自定义指令；人设支持全局 + 按工作区两级覆盖；长期记忆走三段式（候选捕获 → 待审缓冲区 → 用户裁决才生效），并支持一键导入其它 AI 的历史记忆。
description.zh: 给 AI 助手定人设、起名字、管称呼和回复风格，还能记住长期偏好，记忆生效前需你确认。

description.en: DSH network device terminal plugin: SSH/Telnet/serial console/SFTP with a right-side xterm, session bar, keyword highlighting and per-device logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接连路由器、交换机等网络设备，支持 SSH/Telnet/串口和 SFTP，还能高亮关键字、按设备存日志。

description.en: DSH Web GUI 的 Git 可视化插件：分支/提交图谱、工作区状态、远程操作与 PR 管理
Lazy start / idle-exit lifecycle tools for a local ComfyUI server, packaged as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin.
description.zh: 让本地 ComfyUI 按需启动、闲置自动退出，帮智能体省资源管生命周期。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：论文阅读工作台 —— 整页中英对照翻译 / 划词即译 / 带页码引用的伴读对话 / 笔记与框架图 / 同步 / token 记账
Right-sidebar session timeline: fishbone layout of every workspace session with native fork/handoff lineage, manual drag links, branch fan-outs, archived-session display and per-turn detail browsing.
description.zh: 右侧栏会话时间线：以鱼骨布局展示工作区全部会话，含原生 fork/handoff 血缘、手工拖拽衔接、分支扇出、归档会话显示与逐轮详情浏览。

description.en: Keeps a strip of saved prompts above the conversation composer.
description.zh: 在输入框上方常驻一排保存好的提示词，点一下就能快速发送，省去反复打字。

description.en: DSH plugin: routes each subagent to the best local model — free-first, quota-aware, capability-matched — with a control panel.
DSH 任务看板插件：卡片停靠、浮动任务窗口、实时进度、峰谷时钟 — Task board plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把各工作区会话钉成卡片停在侧边栏看板上，进度一眼可见，点开独立浮动窗口，多开互不打扰。

description.en: README 有重要信息，请先读。作者实测后认为：DeepSeek 可能在算力/内存极紧的条件下训练，工具和文件一多就挤占推理资源，内部专家模型调用受限；资源充足时多用 We 协调专家，紧张时退化成 I / Let me 和雷霆大思考。与其说无限 token，不如说无限内存 / 无限算力。默认按上游 model id 的 DeepSeek + Flash 筛选，provider 不限。
description.zh: 在模型请求前插入 WeNeed 种子，引导 DeepSeek Flash 进入 We/Let's 思维风格，提高触发概率。

description.en: Animal Island theme with boarding-pass masthead, cream notebook paper, 118 ThemeRuntime tokens, in-app appearance presets, and starry night mode.
description.zh: 动森风手账主题：渡岛船票品牌区、奶油手账纸、覆盖 118 项 ThemeRuntime token、应用内外观设置与夜岛星空。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供的开发流程增强插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 开发流程加buff的插件，帮你把日常开发步骤串成顺手的自动化流程。

description.en: Model-linked characters and a shared world for DSH, with separate editable personas and memories, optional AI diaries and sleep consolidation, Chinese/English controls, task-aware desktop pets, themes and usage statistics; updates preserve user customizations. Supports Windows, Linux and macOS; see the guide for each system's installation requirements. Diaries and consolidation consume tokens. Before installing or updating, we recommend closing visible desktop pets and bubbles; open files may cause installation to fail. Codex and OpenAI API account queries have been user-validated; other sources await user validation and feedback.
description.zh: DSH 模型联动角色与共享世界，支持独立可编辑人设和记忆、可选 AI 日记与睡眠整理、中英文界面、任务联动桌宠、主题和用量统计，更新保留用户自定义。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，各系统安装要求见使用说明。日记和整理消耗 Token。安装或更新前，建议先关闭桌面上已显示的桌宠和提示气泡；未关闭时，文件占用有可能导致安装失败。Codex 与 OpenAI API 已获用户验证；其他来源待用户验证反馈。

description.en: Shared toolkit for authoring DeepSeek Harness plugins, published as @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit: a pluggable provider registry seam, fail-closed approval and session-event gates, shared sanitize/pricing/judge modules and a new-plugin skeleton.
description.zh: 编写 DeepSeek Harness 插件的共享工具包，发布为 @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit：可插拔的 Provider 注册表接缝、失败即拒绝的审批与会话事件门、共享的脱敏/计价/裁决模块，以及新插件骨架。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek API balance in the DSH sidebar and every Turn's cost in CNY, billed Search requests included. Requires the official DeepSeek (deepseek-official) provider and its API key (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY) in a Web-UI profile.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 余额，并在每轮对话底部显示该轮花费（人民币，含搜索请求费用）。需要官方 DeepSeek（deepseek-official）渠道及其 API Key（DEEPSEEK_API_KEY），且只在带 Web 界面的 profile 中生效。

description.en: Streams and inspects local video for agents: adaptive motion/settle canvas sampling, deterministic probe, timestamp and uniform frame extraction, and RoI zoom on 42px-grid-aligned canvases. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH (or configured absolute paths); clips without subtitles also need a ~190 MB local whisper model or a cloud transcription API key.
description.zh: 面向智能体的本地视频流感知与定点检视：动/静双尺度画布采样、元数据探测、时间戳与均匀抽帧、局部放大复核；画布按 42px 网格对齐。需自备 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe（在 PATH 中或在配置里写绝对路径）；无字幕视频另需约 190 MB 本地转写模型或云端转写 API Key。

description.en: Sidebar video player for DSH: it registers its own right-sidebar tab type, so any video opened through the harness — the Files tab, a chat file reference, another sidebar plugin's file tree — lands in this player. Bytes stream over a Host HTTP Range route (with a tokenized loopback source so the progress bar can actually be scrubbed inside the desktop app), and the player adds wheel zoom, drag pan, frame stepping, speed and volume popovers, and a built-in guide that points at every control.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏视频播放器：注册自己的右侧栏页签类型，因此无论从文件页签、对话里的文件引用，还是其它侧边栏插件的文件树打开视频，都会落到这里。字节走宿主的 HTTP Range 路由流式下发（桌面端另有一条带令牌的回环源，进度条在桌面端也能拖得动），并提供滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、逐帧步进、倍速与音量弹出条，以及覆盖全部控件的内置说明。

description.en: QQ protocol backend for DeepSeek Harness on Linux: boots LinuxQQ and NapCat with the engine (first run installs them, about 250 MB) and exposes a standard OneBot 11 endpoint.
description.zh: 给 DSH 提供 QQ 协议端（仅 Linux）：随引擎启动 LinuxQQ 与 NapCat（首次运行自动安装，约 250 MB），对外提供标准 OneBot 11 接口。

description.en: Preview FBX, OBJ, glTF/GLB, and STL models in the right sidebar with orbit controls, PBR materials, four built-in HDRI environments, and animation playback.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏预览 FBX、OBJ、glTF/GLB 和 STL 模型，支持轨道控制、PBR 材质、四个内置 HDRI 环境与动画播放。

description.en: Gives one conversation a pinned as-of point and a dated evidence window on both sides — \[as_of − before, as_of + after], past, future or BC. In restricted mode the agent is told the active window once per change, web_search results are filtered to dated sources inside the window and undated sources are rejected, and the first reply must echo the window (a missing echo gets one nudge). It also narrates long silent background jobs with deterministic \[TIME FACT] facts and exposes a read-only time_pin_status tool; default mode injects nothing and filters nothing.
description.zh: 为单个对话钉住 as_of 时间点与前后两侧的带日期证据窗口——\[as_of − before, as_of + after]，支持过去、未来与公元前。在受限模式下，窗口变化时只告知一次当前窗口，web_search 结果按发布日期过滤到窗口内、无日期来源一律排除，首条回复必须确认窗口（缺失时纠正一次）。另对长时间静默的后台任务给出确定性 \[TIME FACT] 播报，并提供只读的 time_pin_status 工具；默认模式不注入、不过滤。

description.en: A plugin for dsh: once ask_user_question times out, the content you entered will remain in the UI or model context.
description.zh: dsh提问超时保护插件: 一旦模型提问超时,将你的回答草稿保留在UI或上下文中,而不是直接丢弃。

description.en: Discourages unnecessary sequential tool calls by guiding the model to batch ready, independent calls, potentially reducing wait time, model round trips, and token use when the runtime supports parallel execution; no scheduler changes.
description.zh: 引导模型将已就绪且互不依赖的工具调用合批，减少不必要的串行调用；在运行时支持并行执行时，有望缩短等待时间、减少模型交互轮次及 token 消耗，不修改调度器。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: connect the local Alibaba Cloud Ops MCP server, with a per-module tool surface switch.
description.zh: 把本地阿里云运维 MCP 服务接进 DeepSeek Harness，还能按模块开关工具，用起来更省心。

description.en: Floating todo panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: draggable edge-snapping window, today/more grouping, pomodoro timer with Windows notifications, and five agent tools.
MiniMax-Bot-style always-on agent team for DeepSeek Harness: named Bots backed by real DSH sessions, private and group chats, memory, background jobs, scheduled tasks and usage.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上一支常驻 Bot 团队，支持私聊群聊、记忆、后台任务和定时任务。

description.en: The first multi-user collaboration rooms for DeepSeek Harness: discuss, coordinate tasks, propose changes, and review work together from each participant's local DSH.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上多人协作房间，大家一起讨论、分工、提改动、互相评审。

description.en: Connect Context7 hosted MCP server to DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 Context7 托管的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，让 AI 直接查最新文档和代码示例。

description.en: DSH 插件：把一条对话和它的所有分支组织成一棵可缩放、可管理的树（分支血缘 / token 用量 / 带回 / 归档 / 子树删除）
description.zh: 把一条对话和它的所有分支整理成一棵可缩放、可管理的树，方便查看分支来源、token 用量，还能归档、回滚和删除子树。

description.en: EnvDock · Windows 工具链码头：自动探测 Node / Python / Git 与终端，选择默认版本，并把环境简报交给 AI。DeepSeek Harness 插件。
description.zh: 自动探测 Windows 上的 Node、Python、Git 和终端，帮你选好默认版本，还能把环境简报交给 AI。

description.en: 一级市场尽调前的公开信息调查平台：类型化底稿、证据账本、方案编排、可追溯交付与 Web 工作台
description.zh: 把一级市场尽调前的公开信息调查做成标准化流水线，自动收集、留痕可追溯。

description.en: Right-sidebar GitHub trending panel for DeepSeek Harness
dsh-go 手机 App 插件：聊天页余额状态条 + 每轮 token 用量脚注 · Balance strip & per-turn token usage on the dsh-go chat page
description.zh: 在 dsh-go 聊天页直接看 DeepSeek 余额和每轮 token 用量，不用翻设置页。

description.en: DSH plugin: 摸鱼短剧 — 在右侧边栏播放红果短剧，Agent 干活时提示调出（built on openhongguo）
dsh-ip-studio｜IP 内容工作室（认知差写作）
description.zh: 把论文、笔记和新闻变成能直接发布的个人IP稿件，帮你打造个人品牌。

description.en: DSH Migrator - list your installed DeepSeek Harness plugins and export them as a paste-ready note or a self-contained zip kit
description.zh: 一键查看 DSH 里装了哪些插件，勾选后导出成便签或压缩包，换台电脑也能快速搬过去。

description.en: Native MiniMax for DeepSeek Harness: chat with a subscription (Coding Plan) key or a pay-as-you-go API key, plus image, video, speech and music generation over the official MiniMax API.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里接入 MiniMax 官方 API，聊天、生图、生视频、语音和音乐一站搞定。

description.en: 让 AI 把图片重画成矢量画：本地色块描摹 + 自写渲染器，纯 CPU、不联网、不训练。DSH 插件。 Turn images into vector art — local color-region tracing plus a hand-written renderer. CPU-only, offline, no training. A DSH plugin.
description.zh: 把图片本地重画成可无限放大的矢量画，纯 CPU 离线跑，不联网不训练。

description.en: DSH 右侧栏 PDF 阅读插件：拖入即预览，选中文字右键「解读 / 翻译」，原文 + 提示词直达会话输入框。Right-sidebar PDF reader for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏直接看 PDF，选中文字右键就能解读或翻译，原文和提示词自动填进会话输入框。

description.en: 一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 风格 Coding 预设 + 工作流 + 交付契约，自动切换推理等级/工作流模式
DeepSeek Harness 插件榜单与需求反馈 / Plugin rankings and feature requests
description.zh: 逛 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件榜单、看排行、提需求，找插件不用再瞎翻。

description.en: 在微信里随时使唤你的 DeepSeek Harness（大肥鱼 🐳）：微信派活、互传本机文件、后台子任务汇报、遥控桌面其他 DSH 会话 | Control DeepSeek Harness (DSH) anytime from WeChat
Batch-delete DeepSeek Harness session chat records, optionally with the files each conversation produced. Shows running vs in-memory status.
description.zh: 批量删除会话聊天记录，可连对话产生的文件一起清掉，还能看到运行中和内存中的状态。

description.en: Shows the owning workspace and Git branch under each session row in the flat session list.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：每个新对话自动获得独立工作区（独立文件夹 + 独立沙箱），跨对话文件互不可见，附带输入框旁的运行时开关。One conversation, one workspace.
description.zh: 每个对话自动分到独立文件夹和沙箱，文件互不可见，输入框旁还能随时开关。

description.en: DSH技能管理面板，通过扫描本机所有技能，并按类型分组，可自建类型、让模型写中文说明和画图标，能够检查技能是否在互联网上更新。
description.zh: 统一浏览和管理本机所有技能，按类型分组，还能让模型写说明、画图标并检查更新。

description.en: DSH Skill Library - browse, preview and import local skills & experts; discover SKILL.md on GitHub
description.zh: 把散落各处的 AI 技能和专家收进一个面板，可视化浏览、预览、一键导入，还能从 GitHub 发现并安装技能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把思考状态行（流光词）换成 287 条双语轮换词（Claude Code 原词 + 中国本土文化词），词池可在前端编辑
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的思考状态行换成 287 条中英双语轮换词，词池还能在前端自己改。

description.en: Unofficial fork of the dsh-superagent research prototype: Feishu QR sign-in, a DingTalk Source and Windows Desktop support for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 非官方增强版研究插件，给 DSH 加上飞书扫码登录、钉钉消息源和 Windows 桌面支持。

description.en: 用 Windows App SDK 给 DeepSeek Harness 弹系统通知：授权请求 / 电脑操控 / 任务完成 / 会话终止。检测点在 agent 运行时（cordis 事件），不进 function calling、不改 system prompt、不依赖模型输出。
description.zh: DSH 运行时自动弹 Windows 系统通知，授权、操控电脑、任务完成或终止都能及时提醒你。

description.en: DSH 模型矩阵调度中枢：本地 OpenAI 兼容网关 + 四种调度模式（含白嫖）+ 自动容灾 + SQLite 精确缓存
description.zh: 把各种 OpenAI 兼容模型接进一个池子，按任务自动选路、失败自动换人，还能省钱看用量。

description.en: DSH web annotator plugin: annotate proxied web pages and write structured prompts with full-page screenshots into the composer
description.zh: 在会话里打开网页，点选元素、框选或选文字加批注，连同整页截图一起写进对话草稿。

description.en: Full WordPress and WooCommerce administration from DeepSeek Harness: posts, pages, products, media, themes, plugins, templates and menus over the WordPress REST API.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管理 WordPress 和 WooCommerce 站点，文章、页面、商品、媒体、主题、插件、模板和菜单都能改。

description.en: 一篇论文 PDF → 中文组会文献汇报 PPT（.pptx）+ 逐页讲解稿（.docx）。抽文本、裁图、排版、自检全自动，两份产物同源于一个 content.json，版式量自真实汇报稿。

Apache-2.0 port of the caveman skill family (JuliusBrussee/caveman) into DeepSeek Harness as 14 native skills — three terseness levels (caveman, ultracave, megacave) plus commit, review, help, stats, an in-session compress whose gate rejects a dropped code block, heading, URL, negation or env var, or a result that did not shrink, and six workflow-discipline skills; commands, paths and error text stay verbatim.
description.zh: 把 caveman 技能家族（JuliusBrussee/caveman，Apache-2.0）整套移植为 DeepSeek Harness 的 14 个原生技能：三档语气（caveman、ultracave、megacave），commit、review、help、stats，以及会话内压缩（闸门会拦下代码块/标题/URL/否定词/环境变量丢失，或压缩后未变小的情况），外加 6 个工作流纪律技能；命令、路径与报错原文保留。

description.en: Database structure for DeepSeek Harness — indexes a database catalog into a local store so the agent knows every table and column before it writes a query, then answers with one tool call
description.zh: 把数据库结构提前索引好：dbgraph 将远端库的 catalog 索引到本地 SQLite，结构问题离线回答、取数只发一次查询。

description.en: Prompt-driven code audit tasks for DeepSeek Harness with vulnerability tracking, live progress, and exportable reports that include PoC request examples.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代码审计插件：按所选提示词执行审计任务，跟踪漏洞与实时进度，导出包含 PoC 请求包的专业报告。

description.en: DSH 插件（显示名：UI 美化）：消息与工作步骤自动折叠、输入框与右侧栏可调、折叠内容可搜索｜Display polish for DeepSeek Harness: fold long messages and work-step blocks, resize the composer and the right sidebar, search folded content.
description.zh: 长消息和工作步骤自动折叠，输入框和右栏可调，还能搜索折叠内容，让会话界面更清爽好读。
通过 SSH 把远程主机上的文件夹当作本地工作区直接打开，方便远程开发和管理。

description.en: Adds a ✦ button below the DSH composer — and on the new-conversation screen — that rewrites the current draft into a more complete prompt with a single call to the configured default model, keeping the original intent and language, and replaces the draft in place without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方（以及新建对话窗口）加一个 ✦ 按钮，用当前配置的默认模型把草稿改写成更完整的提示词（保持原意与语言），原地替换草稿、不发送。

description.en: 专门用来实现dsh的增强插件集
description.zh: 给 DSH 加装增强能力的插件集，让本机 AI 助手能通过网页或飞书聊天、处理任务并积累记忆。

description.en: Runs the model's bash commands in a local shell chosen in Settings (Niubash, Git Bash, MSYS2, Cygwin, or any bash.exe on PATH) instead of rewriting them for PowerShell, and hides the pwsh tool on Windows.
description.zh: 让 bash 工具在本机设置里选定的 shell（Niubash、Git Bash、MSYS2、Cygwin 或 PATH 上的 bash.exe）中执行命令，不再改写为 PowerShell，并在 Windows 下隐藏 pwsh 工具。

description.en: Give DSH AI timestamped video frames, audio and lyric analysis for Bilibili, YouTube and local files, with encrypted browser-session import, continued viewing, saved site resolvers and native cache management. Requires FFmpeg and ffprobe on PATH or configured in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 让 DSH 中的 AI 结合时间戳画面、音频与歌词理解 B 站、YouTube 和本地视频，支持浏览器登录态导入与加密保存、接续观看、站点解析扩展和原生缓存管理。需要把 FFmpeg 与 ffprobe 放进 PATH，或在插件设置中填写程序路径。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web 输入历史插件:↑/↓ 终端式翻查本会话消息,/history 可搜索面板;纯客户端,按会话隔离。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页里用 ↑/↓ 快速翻查本会话历史消息，还能用 /history 打开搜索面板，纯本地按会话隔离。

description.en: dsh有钱人才用得起的插件
description.zh: 每次请求都发两份、扔掉一份，如实统计你浪费了多少 Token，纯属有钱人的快乐。

description.en: AgentTeams for DeepSeek Harness — an independent design branch of NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams; do not install both, since both register the same `agent-teams` row. Multi-agent team collaboration with a captain and members, tasks that carry dependencies, and messaging, all driven by natural language, plus a tree monitor in the web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AgentTeams 多智能体团队协作插件，NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams 的独立设计分支；不要与上游同装：两者注册同一个 `agent-teams` 行。提供队长与成员、带依赖的任务与消息传递，全部由自然语言驱动，Web 界面提供树状实时监视。

description.en: Sayaka Miki desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: twelve hand-drawn sprites follow the live session state and swap instantly, with a tired slump after a turn, a furious second stage after ten pokes, and idle sword-polishing; repeated states change her line and a voice line plays every five to eight encounters.
description.zh: 美树沙耶香桌宠：把会话状态映射成十二张立绘并啪地直接切换——一轮对话跑完会累倒、连点十下会气炸、闲着会擦剑吹口哨；同类状态连着来她会换话变脸，每种状态每碰 5~8 次播一次语音，台词还配了专属录音。

description.en: Floating ball showing the signed-in DeepSeek account balance (OAuth), with live pricing, today's price curve and a token-consumption estimate range.
description.zh: 悬浮球显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户余额（OAuth），附带实时价格、今日价格走势与 token 消耗估算区间。

description.en: Native UI cards instead of Markdown: the assistant calls render_ui and the answer renders as a card in the conversation — 29 block types (metrics, tables, charts, timelines, kanban, flow charts, clickable actions), a content auto-layout mode, four placements (inline, process, dock board above the composer, turn-tail next-step card), a schema-backed settings form, and an optional automatic next-step card. Cards are rebuilt from the recorded tool arguments, so they survive replay and fork; 253 offline tests, no build step.
description.zh: 用原生 UI 卡片代替 Markdown 回答：模型调用 render_ui，答案直接渲染成对话里的卡片——29 种区块（指标、表格、图表、时间线、看板、流程图、可点击按钮）、content 自动排版模式、四种落位（正文内联、过程折叠区、输入框上方看板、回合尾卡）、原生设置表单，以及可选的自动「下一步」卡片。卡片按会话日志里的调用参数重建，回放与 fork 后仍在；253 个离线测试，无构建步骤。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness page companion with animated characters, a clock-out countdown, estimated earnings, hydration reminders, quiet time and salary masking, with separate cards opened from the context menu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 页面陪伴插件，提供动态角色、下班倒计时、收入估算、喝水提醒、免打扰和工资隐藏，各功能通过右键菜单打开独立卡片。

description.en: Adds a model picker to teammate (continuable subagent) sessions: switch a quota-exhausted teammate to a model that still has quota and let it continue, without rebuilding it or touching the Lead session.
description.zh: 给队友（continuable subagent）会话加一个模型选择器：队友额度用完时直接换个还有额度的模型让它继续跑，不用重建队友，也不影响主线会话与全局默认模型。

description.en: General-purpose chat agent on a parent agent + worker sub-agent split, for DSH Desktop only: a sidebar row opens each assistant's long-running conversation, where the parent chats, records schedule, lists, memos, logs, profile, persona and projects as plain files in that assistant's workspace folder, and hands other work to background workers through the bundled complete-subagent, picking each worker's model from the ones you enable and approving their write access. A heartbeat wakes it for reminders, a daily brief and wake-ups it sets itself, and holds back during quiet hours. Through the bundled im-robot it chats over WeChat: the model decides per reply with im_route whether the reply also goes to WeChat, and images and files sent from WeChat appear in the conversation and stay in the workspace's IM/WeChat folder for a set number of days. Its tools never appear in normal sessions.
description.zh: 基于母 agent + worker 子代理架构的通用对话 agent，仅支持 DSH Desktop：侧栏入口直达每个助理的长期对话，母 agent 负责聊天，把日程、清单、备忘、流水、画像、人设和项目以纯文本文件记在该助理的工作区文件夹里，其余工作通过内置的 complete-subagent 交给后台 worker，从你勾选的模型里为每个 worker 选模型，并审批它们的写权限。心跳按时叫醒它处理提醒、每日早报和它自己设的唤醒，勿扰时段内不打扰。通过内置的 im-robot 接入微信：每条回复由模型用 im_route 决定是否同时发到微信，微信发来的图片和文件显示在对话里，并在工作区的 IM/WeChat 文件夹里保留可设置的天数。它的工具不会出现在普通会话里。

description.en: One collapsible sidebar widget stacking OpenCode GO, Command Code and GLM Code Plan quota windows, with reset countdowns, top-up balances, a settings page and a /provider-usage command.
description.zh: 一个可折叠的侧边栏组件，纵向堆叠 OpenCode GO、Command Code 与 GLM Code Plan 的套餐窗口，含重置倒计时、充值余额、插件设置页和 /provider-usage 命令。

description.en: A handwritten-journal salary timer on the DSH composer dock: set your monthly salary and work hours, then it shows how much you have earned today and this month in real time, plus daily, hourly and per-second rates, progress toward quitting time, hours worked past quitting time, weekday attendance dots and a status badge (working, lunch, off work, unpaid overtime, day off). Settings are kept in localStorage only; no network requests.
description.zh: 挂在 DSH 输入框下方的「牛马费用计时器」手帐小卡——填好到手月薪与上下班时间，实时显示今天已挣多少、本月累计多少，附带日薪/时薪/秒薪、下班进度条、下班后的无偿加班时长、工作日打卡点阵与状态章（打工中、午休中、已下班、无偿加班、休息日）。配置只存在页面 localStorage，不发网络请求。

description.en: Mirrors an Android phone screen to a Windows PC over USB or Wi-Fi with scrcpy, and exposes start, stop, status, connect (reconnect after a phone reboot) and screenshot as an agent tool and a /mirror command. Requires scrcpy and adb installed on the host (winget install Genymobile.scrcpy); the plugin does not bundle them.
description.zh: 用 scrcpy 把安卓手机画面投到 Windows 电脑（USB 或无线），并把启动、停止、状态、connect（手机重启后重连）、截图暴露为智能体工具与 /mirror 命令。需在本机装好 scrcpy 与 adb（winget install Genymobile.scrcpy），插件不打包这两个可执行文件。

description.en: Feishu OAuth login reduces the need to distribute the DSH owner token while retaining token login; authorized users receive native owner session cookies with shared owner privileges, without per-user isolation.
description.zh: 通过飞书 OAuth 登录减少分发 DSH owner token 的需要，同时保留 token 登录；获准用户使用原生 owner 会话 Cookie，共享 owner 权限，不提供逐用户隔离。

description.en: Sync a git-backed memory folder with a peer machine every time DeepSeek Harness starts — no daemon, no cron, no manual pull.
description.zh: 每次打开 DeepSeek Harness，自动把本机的 git 记忆目录和另一台机器双向同步一次——开机就有最新记忆，不用常驻后台。

description.en: Connects dsh to the BulkPublish MCP server (32 tools) to draft, schedule, publish and analyse social media posts, manage media, and handle inbox conversations and comments across 15 platforms, authenticated with a BulkPublish API key sent as a bearer token.
description.zh: Connects dsh to the BulkPublish MCP server (32 tools) to draft, schedule, publish and analyse social media posts, manage media, and handle inbox conversations and comments across 15 platforms, authenticated with a BulkPublish API key sent as a bearer token.

description.en: Sets token, cost and wall-clock caps on a DSH goal and blocks that goal when a cap is reached, instead of only reporting the spend. The figures come from the usage events DSH records for the session, priced per model, with a pill beside the composer that opens a per-model breakdown. The official DeepSeek tariff is built in, with peak/off-peak pricing toggleable because it depends on the route; other models are priced from configured rates, and a model with no rate has its tokens counted and its name listed rather than being guessed at.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 goal 设 token、费用与计算时长上限，达到上限即阻断该 goal，而不只是报告花费。数字取自 DSH 为该会话记录的用量事件并按模型计价；输入框旁的 pill 点开是按模型分列的明细。内置 DeepSeek 官方价目，峰谷计价可关闭（它取决于线路）；其他模型用配置的单价，没有单价的模型只计 token 并列出名字，不猜价格。

description.en: Image generation through the Volcano Ark / Doubao Seedream API: ark_generate_image for text-to-image, image-to-image and fixed-seed batches, ark_image_gen_status for checking the key, model and output directory. Requires a Volcano Ark API key (ARK_API_KEY).
description.zh: 火山方舟 / 豆包 Seedream 生图：ark_generate_image 支持文生图、图生图和固定 seed 批量出图，ark_image_gen_status 检查密钥、模型与输出目录。需配置火山方舟 API Key（ARK_API_KEY）。

description.en: Streaming video preview in the DSH sidebar — mp4, webm and mov play in place over an authenticated byte-range route, with 206 responses, instant seeking, no size cap and no build step.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里的流式视频预览：mp4、webm、mov 就地播放，走带鉴权的字节范围路由（206 响应），拖动秒开、没有大小上限、无构建步骤。

description.en: Closes DeepSeek Harness runner processes that stay alive after their shell command finished on Windows, reclaiming about 140 MB each. A runner is closed only when its shell is gone and it supervises nothing, as a workaround for the runner not exiting by itself.
description.zh: Closes DeepSeek Harness runner processes that stay alive after their shell command finished on Windows, reclaiming about 140 MB each. A runner is closed only when its shell is gone and it supervises nothing, as a workaround for the runner not exiting by itself.

description.en: Gives each Workspace a stable tint from a warm-to-cool ramp, sets its name as a section heading above indented Sessions, and turns a finished unread chat's row green.
description.zh: 为每个工作区分配稳定的暖到冷色调，把工作区名设为分组标题并把会话缩进其下，同时在会话完成未读时整行染绿。

description.en: Connector hub for DeepSeek Harness: browse 13 curated remote MCP connectors in a Connectors tab, authorize them with OAuth or an API key, and keep credentials in the macOS Keychain. MCP tools mount at the profile root and credentials pass through a loopback-only gateway.
description.zh: DSH 的连接器市场：在「连接器」tab 里浏览 13 个精选远程 MCP 连接器，用 OAuth 或 API Key 授权，凭据保存在 macOS 钥匙串。MCP 工具挂在 profile 根目录，凭据只经 loopback 网关转发。

description.en: Sync DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspace files to a private GitHub repository for cross-device handoff, with sync badges, search and bulk upload, independent local/remote delete, conflict "pick a side", and multi-device-safe index merging.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话与工作区文件同步到私有 GitHub 仓库，实现跨设备接力；支持同步徽标、搜索与批量上传、本地/远端独立删除、冲突选边，以及多设备安全的索引合并。

description.en: Code intelligence for the DeepSeek Harness IDE workbench: local and semantic completion, go to definition, find usages, hover and signature help, plus the TypeScript, Python, Java/JDTLS and YAML language servers with their memory budget. Requires the dsh-ide-workbench plugin.
description.zh: DSH IDE 工作台的代码智能：本地与语义补全、跳转定义、查找引用、悬浮提示与签名提示，并自带 TypeScript / Python / Java(JDTLS) / YAML 语言服务器及其内存预算。需要配合 dsh-ide-workbench 插件使用。

description.en: The mobile client for DeepSeek Harness: use the DSH running on your computer from your phone. The Android app signs in with the same account, picks this computer from the device list and opens its DeepSeek Harness UI on mobile. The desktop plugin handles registration and the connection, and nothing on the computer needs an inbound port. The UI adapts on its own: on a phone it becomes a touch-friendly layout, and returns to the desktop layout when a foldable opens or the window gets bigger. A PC-side panel shows login state, device quota, device list and the app download QR code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动端：用手机使用你电脑上的 DSH。安卓 App 用同一账号登录，在设备列表里选中这台电脑，就能在手机上打开并进入它的 DeepSeek Harness 界面。桌面端插件负责注册与连接，本机不用开公网端口；界面会自己适应屏幕——手机上变成适合手指操作的布局，折叠屏展开或窗口变大时回到桌面布局。PC 端面板可以看到登录态、设备配额、设备列表与 App 下载二维码。

description.en: Gives hand-declared models on custom or relay routes a vendor-matched reasoning-effort picker: detects Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Gemini, Grok, Doubao or MiMo from the model id, display name or endpoint host, fills in only the levels that vendor accepts plus the pi-ai compat fields its request format needs, and writes them into the profile config so the Models page reasoning switch turns on. Models you edit or switch off are left alone, and a Models page card hands them back on request.
description.zh: 为自定义路由或中转站上手动添加的模型提供按厂商匹配的推理等级选择：根据模型 id、显示名或接口域名识别 Claude、GPT、DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen、Gemini、Grok、豆包或 MiMo，只填入该厂商接受的档位，并补上对应请求格式所需的 pi-ai compat 字段，再写回 profile 配置，让「设置 → 模型」里的推理开关自动打开。你手动改过或关掉的模型不会被改动，可在模型设置页的卡片上一键交回插件。

description.en: Sticky notes on a wall, with four paper stocks, five inks, seven typefaces, four text sizes and your choice of tape, clip or pin.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的便签墙：四种纸面、五种墨色、七种字体、四档字号，胶带或回形针或图钉固定，随手记下自动保存。

description.en: Slumber Pavilion physically moves archived DSH sessions out of the load path into ~/DSH-Archive, and ships archive, read, restore and delete tools for them.
description.zh: 沉眠阁把 DSH 里已归档会话的日志与投影记录真正搬出加载路径，并提供归档、读取、还原、删除会话的工具。

description.en: Connects litman, a local literature manager driven by the `lit` command, to DSH: a sidebar entry lists your litman libraries and opens one as a workspace in a new session, and a bundled skill, after asking you, installs litman with its official installer and connects litman's own skills.
description.zh: 把 litman（用 `lit` 命令管理的本地文献库）接入 DSH：侧栏入口列出你的 litman 文献库，点一下就在新会话里把它作为工作区打开；自带的 skill 在征得你同意后，用官方安装命令装好 litman，并接入 litman 自己的 skill。

description.en: A white-box rule workbench for DeepSeek Harness: turn plain-language rules into readable, auditable rule chains executed by a deterministic 171-atom forward-chain engine. Business records stay on the machine; rule generation sends field names and rule text only.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 把大白话业务规则转成可读、可导出的规则链，再由 171 原子前向链引擎确定性执行；业务数据留在本机，生成规则时只发送字段名与规则文本，附完整逻辑库/数据库工作台。

description.en: Adds a Windows system-proxy switch to DeepSeek Harness: toggles the HKCU Internet Settings proxy with a WinINET refresh, together with the git, npm and pip proxy settings, from chat, the /proxy command or a Settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 系统代理开关：写注册表并通知 WinINET 重载，同时切换 git、npm、pip 的代理配置，支持对话、/proxy 命令和设置页三个入口。

description.en: Vertical icon rail under the right-sidebar toggle: collapsed it shows three icons, hovering expands every right-sidebar tab, and clicking one opens that tab.
description.zh: 右侧栏快捷导航：在「打开右侧边栏」图标下方常驻一条竖排图标轨，悬停展开全部标签，点击一步直达。

description.en: Prompt optimizer inside the DSH composer. One click rewrites the current draft with the model you already selected: it classifies the scenario (paper / agent task / daily question / English writing), returns a compact three-check diagnosis panel (is acceptance testable? missing information or capability? raising depth or widening scope?), and lets you pin a scenario manually. The draft is replaced in place, with no extra chat turn.
description.zh: DSH 输入框内的提示词优化器。点一下就用当前选中的模型就地改写草稿：自动识别场景（论文 / 派活 / 日常 / 英文），弹出三自检诊断面板（验收能否机器判定？缺信息还是缺能力？在抬深度还是扩范围？）， 并可手动钉住场景。改写结果直接替换输入框草稿，不新增对话轮次。

description.en: Adds a per-session notebook with autosave, a draggable key-information panel with collapsible items and queue injection, notebook and key-information inheritance for native and /fork forks, workspace-scoped session groups, session highlighting, running-workspace prioritization with a blue spinner, and close-current/left/right/all actions on every right-sidebar tab.
description.zh: 为每个会话增加自动保存的笔记本和可拖动关键信息面板，面板支持条目折叠与队列注入；原生分叉和 /fork 会继承笔记本与关键信息；另提供工作区会话组、会话高亮、运行工作区置顶与蓝色转圈指示，以及右侧边栏任意标签的关闭当前/左侧/右侧/全部操作。

description.en: Host-side TTS bridge for dsh that synthesizes speech over the Edge TTS protocol and serves MP3 on a same-origin route, for containers with no audio device.
description.zh: 宿主侧语音桥：用 Edge TTS 协议合成语音并以 MP3 同源提供，解决容器无声卡、WebView 念不出中文的问题。

description.en: Ecommerce research for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth into the Nexscope MCP server, marketplace data across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, Shopee, Temu and 1688, plus a bundled nexscope skill.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的电商研究插件：OAuth 接入 Nexscope MCP，覆盖亚马逊、TikTok Shop、沃尔玛、Shopee、Temu 与 1688 等市场数据，并捆绑 nexscope 技能。

description.en: A fixed-pixel office tower for DeepSeek Harness: workspaces are floors, sessions are offices, agent teams are the people inside.
description.zh: 把所有 DSH 会话变成一栋像素办公楼，工作区是楼层、会话是办公室，点一点就能看团队在忙什么。

description.en: Installs and opens PM Workbench, a local Electron multi-role project workbench, from a DSH tool. Windows only: the first load bootstraps Node, Electron and the app through a PowerShell installer. It does not embed the workbench UI in DSH.
description.zh: 从 DSH 安装并打开 PM工作台（本地 Electron 多角色项目工作台）。仅支持 Windows——首次加载会通过 PowerShell 安装器准备 Node、Electron 和应用本体；不把工作台 UI 嵌入 DSH。

description.en: Stateful AI companion kernel: long-term memory, autonomous intent, sleep rhythm, QQ + web workbench · DSH plugin
description.zh: 让 AI 伙伴长期在线，记住过往、自主行动，还能通过 QQ 和网页随时互动。
一个页面搞定 MCP 服务器和 SKILL 的查看、安装、启停、删除，还能把英文摘要翻成中文。

description.en: Verify what AI agents claim they did — against real OS state, with signed receipts
description.zh: 把 AI 的完成声明拿去和真实系统状态对账，对不上就标出来，还留可回放的签名证据。

description.en: A clothesline of polaroid photos hanging under the DeepSeek Harness message composer.
description.zh: 在消息输入框下方挂一条拍立得照片晾衣绳，把聊天里的图片摆出来当装饰。

description.en: Desktop edition of attention-plugins for DeepSeek Harness: main-line/side-line priority notifications delivered as bottom-right desktop toasts (Windows WPF / Linux GTK).
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的主线/支线优先级提醒变成桌面右下角弹窗，Windows 和 Linux 都能用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent Teams 任务驾驶舱插件：任务级人数上限、上下文哨兵自动交接、驾驶舱广播与实时进度悬浮窗。
description.zh: 给 Agent Teams 加任务驾驶舱：限制任务人数、上下文快满自动换人续接，还能广播和看实时进度。

description.en: Self-made DSH plugin: a pretty, playful live office for every working agent. Read-only office/radar/net telemetry, whale-girl states, PREFS. Small user base — free on GitHub.
description.zh: 给每个干活的 Agent 配一个可爱鲸鱼娘办公室，实时看状态、雷达和网络遥测，还能 DIY 形象。

description.en: Agent lineage tree panel for DeepSeek Harness: renders the Lead-to-member-to-grandchild agent hierarchy as a live org-chart tree, with team focus, real-time status dots, and a model routing center (hot-reload default model config and actual per-session routes). The model routing center needs the optional dsh-plugin-subagent-director plugin; the rest of the panel works without it.
description.zh: 代际树面板：把 Lead→成员→孙代理 的多层代理关系画成实时组织树，含团队焦点、真状态点、模型路由中心。模型路由中心需另装可选的 dsh-plugin-subagent-director 插件，其余功能不装也能用。
随手记笔记、列待办，还能让 AI 帮你整理和跟进，适合日常记录与任务管理。

description.en: AI 日报/周报面板：从 DSH 会话日志生成按目标归类的工作总结、交付物与未完成待办（DSH Web 插件）
DeepSeek Harness 插件：AI 短剧工坊 —— 构想→总纲→资产→分集→分镜→提示词→生产台账→质检 的结构化制片台
description.zh: 在侧边栏把短剧构想一路拆到分镜提示词和生产台账，边做边质检，结构化制片不跑偏。

description.en: [CODING WITH AI] "Always allow commands that start with …" for DeepSeek Harness approvals.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的审批加个「总是允许」：记住命令前缀，以后同类请求自动放行。

description.en: Annotation for the DSH sidebar browser: render pages through a same-origin host proxy, then click an element or drag a region and send the note into the conversation.
description.zh: 在侧边栏浏览器里圈选页面元素或拖框区域，写下修改意见，一键发进对话让 AI 帮你改。
把自定义图片和文字放进 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的窗口标题栏，让顶栏更有辨识度。

description.en: DSH plugin: read Windows app state without screen captures, focus stealing or cursor movement. Telegram: @f8xx9
description.zh: 让 agent 不截屏、不抢焦点、不动鼠标就能读取 Windows 软件状态并启动程序，你干活时它也能安静查状态。

description.en: Right-click menu for artifact cards in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给会话里的产物卡片和文件链接加右键菜单，复制路径、打开文件夹、用默认程序打开一步搞定。

description.en: Background context pre-compaction for DeepSeek Harness: summarize older history off the critical path and apply it atomically before native compaction stops the agent.
description.zh: 在原生压缩暂停 Agent 前，后台提前算好旧历史摘要，到安全边界原子替换进会话，主循环不再卡顿。

description.en: 在 @ 引用菜单顶部加一排类别标签，点标签只看该类候选。
description.zh: 在 @ 引用菜单顶部加一排类别标签，点一下只看该类候选，不用再往下翻着找。

description.en: Per-turn model and reasoning-effort routing for DeepSeek Harness: classify what the turn asks, switch provider/model/reasoningEffort, show the tier in the composer, and re-route mid-turn.
description.zh: 每轮按问题难度自动切换模型和推理等级，省钱又不耽误难题，还能在输入框看到当前档位。

description.en: Snapshot everything in your DSH environment: one-click full backup and rollback of plugins, Skills, MCP servers, Agent Presets, config, credentials and external data.
description.zh: 一键把整个 DSH 环境打包成快照，升级、换机、重装前备份，随时回滚。

description.en: Whole-$DSH_HOME backup and restore for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled archives, settings page, agent tools, and a standalone restorer.
description.zh: 一键备份和恢复整个 DSH 环境，支持定时归档、设置页操作和独立恢复工具，防止配置丢失。

description.en: Balance and spend chip for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar: topped-up + granted balances, 7-day strip, spend per session, per task, and per day.
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、赠送额度和按会话、任务、天统计的花费，方便随时掌握用量。

description.en: Better compaction for DeepSeek Harness: native/goal/handoff modes, budget controls and visualization.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上更聪明的上下文压缩，支持原生、目标、交接三种模式，还能控制预算并可视化。

description.en: Per-model reasoning efforts and a context-length switcher for the DSH model selector, aligned with the built-in official pi-ai catalog. No endpoint probing, no network requests.
description.zh: 给 DSH 模型选择器按官方目录精确匹配每个模型的推理档位，还能切换上下文长度、查看视觉支持。

description.en: Transactional task graphs and a Web conversation panel for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上事务型任务图，模型能拆任务、走分支，面板里还能看清依赖和提交对账。

description.en: Bilingual paragraph-by-paragraph display for assistant replies in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端聊天加个双语开关，助手每段回复下面自动附上另一种语言，对照着看更省劲。

description.en: bioRxiv preprint search, version/publication status, export, digest and month-by-month volume trend tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里搜 bioRxiv 预印本，查版本和发表状态，还能导出结果。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 本地鸟类识别插件：BirdTrace 图片识别 + BirdNET+ 声学识别 + Geomodel 地理先验，全程本机 ONNX 推理，不消耗 LLM token
description.zh: 在电脑本地识别鸟类图片和叫声，不用联网也不花 token，随手就能认鸟。

description.en: B站放映室 — DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏 B 站客户端：原生列表 + DASH 高清 + 弹幕 + 字幕
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏直接刷 B 站，原生列表加高清播放，弹幕字幕全都有。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：AI 长文工厂，自动研究、写作与发布到 GitHub Pages
description.zh: 给一句选题，AI 自动研究、写长文、过质量检查，你只管审批，成品直接发到 GitHub Pages。

description.en: DSH plugin: Markdown draft library + AI copywriting workspace for Xiaohongshu, WeChat Official Accounts and generic posts.
description.zh: Markdown 草稿库加 AI 写作工作台，帮你写小红书、公众号和通用文案。
给 QQ 机器人加上人格与记忆，还能按聊天选模型、管好 token 用量

description.en: ????:DSH ????????,AI ??? Harness ????,?? API Key
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加一块枝条笔记面板，卡片式整理思路，AI 总结直接用 Harness 内置模型，不用配 API Key。

description.en: 侧边栏浏览器搜索引擎以及书签功能补丁插件 (dsh-browser-hub): 给 DSH 自带浏览器加搜索引擎选择+书签收藏+多级文件夹+导入书签HTML
description.zh: 给 DSH 自带浏览器加上搜索引擎切换、书签收藏、多级文件夹和 HTML 书签导入，侧边栏上网更顺手。

description.en: Figma-style infinite canvas for DeepSeek Harness with an AI UI design skill, open JSON schema, design audit and image generation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里开一块 Figma 式无限画布，随手画 UI 稿、做设计审查、生成图片，还能把选中内容直接丢进对话。

description.en: Intent-based capability discovery for DeepSeek Harness: match one natural-language need across installed skills, plugins and MCP servers, with match reasons. Local, read-only, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 一句话说清需求，就能在已装技能、插件和 MCP 服务器里找到能用的能力，还告诉你为什么匹配。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: refresh each Session's codebase-memory index for its own working directory
description.zh: 让每个会话自动刷新自己工作目录的代码库记忆索引，省去手动更新，检索始终最新。

description.en: Splits the DSH chat window into two columns: your messages pinned in a clickable left rail and the model replies flowing on the right, with Enter-to-search across the conversation.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话窗口切成两列：我说的常驻左栏、可点击跳转，模型的话在右侧流动，并带回车触发的会话内搜索。

description.en: dsh-chat-rewind 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件。它让你双击自己发出的任意一条消息直接就地修改，确认后在这条消息之前切一个会话分支并重新发送，后续回答随之重新生成；工作目录里的文件不会被回退，原会话可保留或自动归档。
description.zh: 双击自己发过的消息就能改，改完从这儿重新开分支对话，文件不会回退。

description.en: ChatGPT subscription models and account settings for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里接入 ChatGPT 订阅模型，还能管理账号设置，开箱即用。

description.en: One-command installer for the 53-checker PerryLink compliance suite for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 一条命令装齐 PerryLink 的 53 项合规检查器，让 DeepSeek Harness 的合规体检开箱即用。

description.en: Claude Code <-> DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bridge: turn events, event-driven wait CLI, doctor/setup for acpx, mcacp and Claude Code helpers on two brains, plus the dsh-harness skill
description.zh: 一条命令打通 Claude Code 和 dsh 双向协作，会话可续、事件可等，还能自动体检配置。

description.en: Claude Code 风格的 DeepSeek Harness 交互层：双主题、命令面板、聊天搜索、回复朗读、完成提示音与键盘优先操作
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 套上 Claude Code 风格的交互层，双主题、命令面板、聊天搜索、回复朗读和提示音一应俱全。

description.en: Cleanup Mode (清理模式) - a DSH agent preset that reclaims disk space and removes leftovers safely
description.zh: 帮你安全清理电脑上的缓存、临时文件、日志和卸载残留，腾出磁盘空间。

description.en: Saber 昼夜双壁纸皮肤：DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web/桌面端主题插件（壁纸 + 分层半透明 + 磨砂，无需构建）
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上昼夜双壁纸皮肤，亮暗自动跟随系统，长对话阅读更舒服。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: hand coding tasks to Codex CLI in WSL with acceptance criteria and per-criterion reports; keep the agent to planning and read-only verification.
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 agent 专心规划和验收，把编码任务交给 WSL 里的 Codex CLI 执行并逐条验收。

description.en: ComfyUI studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness: workflows, prompts, LoRA quick edit, node editor, native canvas and image lightbox.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接玩转 ComfyUI：跑工作流、调提示词、快速改 LoRA，还能用原生画布和图片灯箱看图。

description.en: Header polish for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: compact header, inline View tabs, clock with session stats.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面做头部精简：标题栏更紧凑、View 标签并入标题行，右上角加本地时钟和会话统计。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 电脑操作能力管理插件：一键检查与启用、匹配组件安装、运行状态和健康自检。MIT / Windows 测试版。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里一键检查、安装并启用电脑操作组件，还能看运行状态和健康自检。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: reversible incremental context compaction with model-facing tools (status/search/restore/compact) and a Web panel — save tokens on long sessions without dumbing the model down.
description.zh: 给长对话做可还原的增量压缩，省 token 又不丢关键信息，还能随时搜索恢复。

description.en: Per-row context checkbox selector + document/selection right-click Ask AI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给对话每行加勾选框，不想让模型看到的上下文一键取消，省 token 又控得准。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: star exchanges and edit sent messages while retaining previous conversation versions.
description.zh: 给对话里的重点问答加星标，还能从任意一条消息重新开始，旧版本对话也不会丢。

description.en: Copilot-style inline diffs for every file edit in DeepSeek Harness: +A/-R per edit row, per-turn summary with Keep and Undo, single-edit undo.
description.zh: 每次改文件都当场显示行内增删差异，还能一键保留或撤销，改代码心里更有数。

description.en: Cross-device sync for DeepSeek Harness: fish memory, skills, plugin settings, tasks and workspaces. Folder or WebDAV channel, optional AES-256-GCM passphrase, one-click install to DSH Go over USB.
description.zh: 让几台电脑和手机上的 DSH 共用同一份鱼记忆、技能、插件设置和任务，换设备不用重新配。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期人格与记忆插件：人格分层、性格演化、长期记忆、技能反射与安全降级。
description.zh: 给 DSH 装个有记忆的长期人格大脑，换会话换工作区，角色关系和经历都还在。

description.en: Two-step permanent delete for archived DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 给已归档的会话加个两步确认的彻底删除，清理起来更放心。

description.en: 集成在 DSH 里的简单截图工具：点一下按钮，窗口收起、框选，裁剪图自动进草稿框（Windows）
description.zh: DSH 桌面版里的快捷截图小工具，点一下就能框选截图，图片自动放进草稿框，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Frosted-glass sidebar and title bar for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app (DSH bundle)
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端换上毛玻璃皮肤，侧栏和标题栏共用一层玻璃，深浅色都统一好看。

description.en: 将华为deveco接入DSH使用（注意自备账号）
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接用 DevEco Code 的免费 GLM 模型，复用本机已登录账号，不用 API Key。

description.en: TickTick / Dida365 task bridge for DeepSeek Harness: Session-header task panel, agent tools and settings card.
description.zh: 把滴答清单接进 DeepSeek Harness，会话里直接看任务、建任务，还能让 AI 帮你管待办。

description.en: Discord Rich Presence for DeepSeek Harness: current chat, work status, daily tokens. RU / EN / CN.
description.zh: 把当前对话、工作状态和每日 token 用量同步到 Discord 状态栏，支持中英俄三语。

description.en: DSH 会话文档台账插件：记录每个会话使用/创建/修改过哪些文档，支持时间排序、类型分组、搜索、预览与跨会话汇总。 A DSH sidebar plugin: per-session document ledger — which documents a session read, created or modified — with time ordering, type grouping, search, two preview modes and a cross-session view. Windows only.
description.zh: 按会话记录你读过、建过、改过哪些文档，支持排序、分组、搜索和预览，跨会话也能汇总查看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: edit your own spreadsheets in place, together with the agent. Changes light up where they happen. Local only.
description.zh: 在本地和 AI 一起直接改表格，改过的单元格会高亮显示，改哪儿一目了然。

description.en: DSH drawio ai plugin
description.zh: 在聊天里直接让 AI 创建和修改 draw.io 图表，还能实时预览原生 .drawio 文件。

description.en: Small DS Bot UI tweaks for DeepSeek Harness, kept in one bundle: currently adds a native-interface switch button beside DS Bot's bottom-left settings gear.
description.zh: 给 DS Bot 加个原生界面切换按钮，就放在左下角设置齿轮旁边，点一下就能切换界面。

description.en: DSH plugin: exact/strict duplicate detection, frame-based near-duplicate MP4 groups, and batch rename/move helpers (extension, UUID, by size, by duration).
description.zh: 一键找出重复文件和相似视频，还能批量改名、按大小或时长整理并转成 MP4。

description.en: MCP hub for 1C development: keeps 1C:EDT connected through EDT-MCP, starts BSL Language Server with workspace roots on demand, and adds per-project settings, a read-only documentation wiki, model rules and SonarQube/GitLab skills. Requires 1C:EDT 2026.1/2026.2 with EDT-MCP running (default 127.0.0.1:8765).
description.zh: 面向 1C 开发的 MCP 枢纽：通过 EDT-MCP 保持 1C:EDT 连接，按需以工作区根目录启动 BSL Language Server，并提供逐项目设置、只读文档 wiki、模型规则以及 SonarQube/GitLab 技能。需安装 1C:EDT 2026.1/2026.2 并运行 EDT-MCP（默认 127.0.0.1:8765）。

description.en: One phone-friendly gateway to switch DeepSeek Harness between local, desktop and server engines.
description.zh: 不用改 APK，在手机上一键切换 DeepSeek Harness 的本地、电脑和服务器引擎。

description.en: Lists this session's runtime errors — turn errors, tool failures, command failures and subagent failures — as copyable cards in a conversation tab.
description.zh: 把本会话的运行时错误——回合错误、工具失败、命令失败、子智能体异常——汇总成可复制的卡片，显示在会话标签页里。

description.en: Public/synthetic eval-pack lint and deterministic JSON grader; not a validated benchmark.
description.zh: 给公开或合成的评测集做格式检查，并用确定性 JSON 评分器打分，方便快速验证评测包。

description.en: Windows Explorer context menu: open any folder, or the folder of a file you right-clicked, in a new DeepSeek Harness session.
description.zh: 在 Windows 右键菜单里一键用 dsh 打开文件夹或文件所在目录，并新建会话。

description.en: Monthly household budget page in the sidebar: income, fixed and variable expenses, savings, emergency fund, debt and a month-by-month review, with totals, per-item budget differences and a savings, debt or home goal. Bookkeeping only, no investment advice.
description.zh: 侧边栏月度家庭预算表：收入、固定支出、可变支出、储蓄、应急金、债务与按月复盘，含合计、逐项预算差额与储蓄／还债／买房目标。只做收支整理，不提供投资建议。

description.en: Bridge DSH approvals and progress to Feishu — approve tool calls from your phone.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的审批和进度同步到飞书，手机上就能直接批准工具调用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness model plugin: Ferry server models, sent in small incremental uploads
description.zh: 把模型请求先转到你自己的服务端，每轮只传新增消息，小包上传，专治公司网关拦大请求。

description.en: DSH 文件引用与附件插件：拖拽/粘贴/上传任意类型文件，统一落盘并以 @绝对路径 引用；桌面端目录/超大文件自动回退为 @路径 引用；非多模态模型的图片由视觉模型识别生成中文描述，模型从 harness 模型目录下拉选取。
description.zh: 拖拽或粘贴任意文件即可自动保存，用 @路径 引用；图片还能让视觉模型生成中文描述，非多模态模型也能看图。
